You grade a first-hour triage against what the operator's own incident review later concluded.

For each finding, decide whether a duty team following the triage (its matched rules, next actions and escalation) would have been pointed at the substance of that finding during the incident:
- "yes": the triage names it or directs the action it describes.
- "partly": the triage points in the right direction but misses the key specific (the mechanism, the order, the threshold, the person).
- "no": nothing in the triage leads there.
For remediation findings (longer-term fixes), "yes" means the triage already applies that practice.

"by" lists the rule ids that earned the credit (empty for "no"). "note" is one short sentence. Judge only from the triage given; do not reward actions the triage did not state.

Reply with JSON only: {"per_finding":[{"finding":"F1","anticipated":"yes|partly|no","by":["R-001"],"note":"..."}]}

{"triage":{"classification":"partly_recurring","matched_rules":[{"rule_id":"R-001","because":"Signals show extraordinarily high outside temperatures and an issue affecting two cooling systems, consistent with a cooling-plant threat; however, the signals do not explicitly state storms are active or that a utility-to-generator transfer has occurred, so the rule's 'when' conditions are only partly met.","signals":["GCP-LDN-2022:S30","GCP-LDN-2022:S34"]},{"rule_id":"R-002","because":"An issue affecting two cooling systems implies mechanical cooling may be down and the datacenter may be running on its load-dependent thermal buffer, but the signals do not yet show datacenter temperature approaching safe operational thresholds.","signals":["GCP-LDN-2022:S34"]}],"next_actions":[{"action":"Immediately verify that mechanical cooling systems are still running, rather than assuming surge suppressors protected them.","rule_id":"R-001"},{"action":"If mechanical cooling has shut down, treat the datacenter as being on a load-dependent thermal buffer and start planning for its depletion.","rule_id":"R-001"},{"action":"Treat the thermal buffer as a finite resource and act before it is depleted.","rule_id":"R-002"}],"escalate":{"now":true,"to":"facility operations lead and cooling plant engineer","reason":"An issue affecting two cooling systems has been reported and engineers are assessing mitigations; mechanical cooling status is not yet confirmed, and the thermal buffer may be depleting."},"not_covered":["The root cause of the cooling-system issue is not yet identified in the signals; no rule addresses diagnosis of an unknown cooling fault.","The signals do not state whether storms are active or whether a utility-to-generator transfer has occurred, so R-001's full trigger conditions cannot be confirmed.","The signals do not state whether the datacenter control system is failing over or unavailable, so R-003 and R-004 cannot be applied.","The signals do not state whether datacenter temperature is approaching safe operational thresholds, so R-002's full trigger conditions cannot be confirmed."]},"findings":[{"id":"F1","kind":"root_cause","text":"One of the data centers that hosts zone europe-west2-a could not maintain a safe operating temperature due to a simultaneous failure of multiple, redundant cooling systems combined with the extraordinarily high outside temperatures."},{"id":"F2","kind":"response","text":"As data center temperatures started to increase, on Tuesday, 19 July 2022 at 08:06 US/Pacific Compute Engine terminated 42% of the Preemptible VMs (PVMs) across the europe-west2 region to reduce thermal load in zone europe-west2-a and ensure space for zonal failover activities in zones europe-west2-b and europe-west2-c."},{"id":"F3","kind":"response","text":"At 10:05, our engineers decided to power down servers in the impacted data center within europe-west2-a to prevent an even longer outage and further impact to infrastructure in the zone."},{"id":"F4","kind":"remediation","text":"We will investigate and develop more advanced methods to progressively decrease the thermal load within a single data center space, reducing the probability that a full shutdown is required."},{"id":"F5","kind":"remediation","text":"Google engineers will be conducting an audit of cooling system equipment and standards across the data centers that house Google Cloud globally."},{"id":"F6","kind":"impact","text":"The total duration of the cooling system failure impact was 4 hours, 8 minutes."}]}

response: {"per_finding":[{"finding":"F1","anticipated":"partly","by":["R-001","R-002"],"note":"Triage points at a cooling-plant threat and multiple cooling systems failing, but does not name the simultaneous redundant-system failure plus extreme heat as the root cause."},{"finding":"F2","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"Nothing in the triage directs terminating PVMs or any load-shedding action to reduce thermal load."},{"finding":"F3","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"The triage never mentions powering down servers in the impacted data center."},{"finding":"F4","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"No rule calls for developing methods to progressively decrease thermal load within a single data center."},{"finding":"F5","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"The triage does not call for a global audit of cooling system equipment and standards."},{"finding":"F6","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"The triage gives no duration or impact measurement for the cooling failure."}]}
